en.headline: Police College to offer funded honours degree for junior officers
en.dek: The force says a new applied degree in security and criminal investigation will recruit later this year and start classes in March.
body: The Hong Kong Police College will offer a fully funded honours degree for junior officers who do not already hold a bachelor's degree, the force said in an announcement reported early on Friday.

The programme is an applied degree in security and criminal investigation. Police said the college passed a Hong Kong Council for Accreditation of Academic and Vocational Qualifications assessment in August, and is the first government department cleared to run a bachelor's course.

Recruitment is expected to open toward the end of the year, with classes starting in March. Reports citing the force said a junior-year stream would offer about 80 places a year for officers with a secondary education, taking about four years, while a senior-year stream of about 40 places would be open to serving constables and sergeants who already hold a sub-degree or higher diploma, over about two years.
The force said it hoped the route would encourage more people to join. Successful students would be able to go on to master's study, it added.

zh.headline: 警察學院開辦員佐級榮譽學士課程 學費由警隊全額資助
zh.dek: 警方表示，安保及刑事調查應用學位課程年底招生，明年三月開課，對象為未持學士學位的員佐級人員。
body: 香港警察學院將為尚未持有學士學位的員佐級人員開辦全額資助的榮譽學士課程。警方在周五凌晨公布的消息指，課程屬應用學位，名稱為安保及刑事調查（榮譽）警務學士。
警方表示，學院今年八月通過香港學術及職業資歷評審局評審，成為首個獲准開辦學士學位課程的政府部門。
課程預計年底招生，明年三月開課。引述警方的報道指，「初年級」每年約八十個學額，對象為中學學歷警員，修畢約需四年；「高年級」約四十個學額，除銜接外，亦開放予已持副學士或高級文憑的現職警員或警長，修讀約兩年。
警方稱，課程有助吸引更多人投考警隊，學員取得學士學位後亦可銜接碩士課程。
